video_title: Will Steph Curry end career with Warriors after signing extension? | Dan Le Batard Show | NBA on NBC

quotes.speaker: Dan Le Batard
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's uncertain future with the Golden State Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to bet it doesn't end in Golden State.
quotes.quote: I'm curious as to how that's going to end for him in Golden State because if I had to bet, I'm going to bet it doesn't end in Golden State. Even though they've all said the correct things. We were talking earlier in the show about Bobrovsky and what it is that he's earned with two championships in Florida and the answer was not much. Steph Curry's allegiance to that city, that city's allegiance to Steph Curry. How's that end? Because I don't have a lot of examples of any of that ending well.

quotes.speaker: Chris Wittyngham
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's two-year extension mirrors Dirk Nowitzki's late career
quotes.excerpt: This feels like a Dirk Nowitzki situation.
quotes.quote: If he hadn't signed a two-year extension, I would totally anticipate it. I thought going into this season that his upcoming free agency would be one of the major storylines as we headed toward the trade deadline because you would see teams want to trade into that space or have other teams take on the Jimmy Butler contract as all of that was going on. But now that he signed the two-year extension, it makes it seem like at least for now, his goal is to play this out, hope that he can ride it out with some other veterans around him to make some sort of run, but this feels like a Dirk Nowitzki situation.

quotes.speaker: Dan Le Batard
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's unique global impact as a singular star
quotes.excerpt: He is an international global icon for being the small guy who's able to dominate that sport.
quotes.quote: I don't think that people properly understand what it has been to be Steph Curry over the 10 years of basketball where he's trying to take LeBron James's place in the sport. When Steph Curry wanders around the globe, he does so as a singular star presence that isn't about the Warriors, it's about Steph Curry redefining shooting. He is an international global icon for being the small guy who's able to dominate that sport. He is a rock star. Every single city he goes to, it is an event when he goes there.

quotes.speaker: Dan Le Batard
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden State's inability to compete with younger, deeper teams
quotes.excerpt: The teams at the top of your conference are so much younger and so much deeper.
quotes.quote: The teams at the top of your conference are so much younger and so much deeper than you and have created an impossible gulf to overcome. They're not close to the Warriors, they're not close to the Thunder and Spurs. They're a million miles from the Thunder and Spurs. They don't have a real championship chance and I just think that if you're Steph Curry, you're going to miss playing in the most meaningful games.

quotes.speaker: Dan Le Batard
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's contract extension prioritizes financial security
quotes.excerpt: He did what Kawhi just did, signed for two years and it'll probably be in Toronto.
quotes.quote: Because you've got to get your money where it is. Instead of making the mess, he's guaranteed his money no matter where it is. He did what Kawhi just did, signed for two years and it'll probably be in Toronto, but you get the two years. He did what Jimmy Butler wanted to do down here. Guarantee me the two years, it doesn't matter. I want to be paid 37, 38, 39 years old. I want to get my money no matter where it is.
